links.comparator_used: Static base model trained on 2016-2017 data and not updated, tested on rolling quarterly data from 2018 to 2023
links.outcome: Discrimination (AUROC) and mean daily bed error for hospital admission prediction
links.effect: Base model mean AUROC 0.875 (range 0.844-0.887) and mean daily bed error 7.42 beds (range 0.47-13.1); retrained models mean AUROC 0.892 (quarterly) and 0.893 (half-yearly), bed error 4.02 (quarterly) and 4.48 (half-yearly) beds per day; calibration and classification performance similar
links.quote: Retrained models demonstrated improved discrimination (mean AUROC 0.892 and 0.893) and reduced bed error (4.02 and 4.48 beds per day) for quarterly and half-yearly retraining, respectively, with similar calibration and classification performance.

design_hint: scheduled model retraining and drift monitoring
